title: Triage and merge the open Dependabot CI-action bumps (audit A1)
summary: Five open Dependabot PRs (#1-5) bump GitHub Actions by major versions (actions/checkout 4->7, actions/setup-python 5->7, actions/setup-dotnet 4->6, actions/cache 4->6, game-ci/unity-builder 4->6). Supply-chain hygiene, but major bumps can change behavior. Rebase each onto main and merge only on green CI; hold any that breaks a workflow with a one-line note. Surfaced by the M0 audit (governance/checkpoints/M0.md, finding A1).

acceptance_tests.test: Each open Dependabot action-bump PR (#1-5) is rebased onto main and merged only after its CI is green; any bump that breaks a workflow is held (not merged) with a one-line reason.
After merges, the pinned action versions in .github/workflows/*.yml are current and all workflows still parse and pass on main.
